excluded.reason: Separate ARAYOT heading after supplied Qidd. 4:14, outside seven requested Nashim tractates

findings: No missing source sections after explicit content-bound splits and cross-file opening mappings.
Sotah 9:2 maps two supplied sections, 9:2 and 9:4. The source K witness has no separate 9:4 ID.
Supplied display numbers differ from source reference IDs; never substitute display counters for source IDs.
All editorial annotations, brackets, correction marks, and unpointed forms remain in the original spans; processing must treat them conservatively.
No Lex/Tag morphology lines appear in these four supplied reference inputs. No morphology is established by this audit.
Eight internal source/reference segmentation differences were resolved explicitly: Yevamot 2:5/6, 4:13/14, 9:2/3, 16:3/4; Gittin 9:9/10; Sotah 3:1/2, 9:12/13, plus Sotah 9:2/9:4 supplied numbering.
Three unlabelled file openings map to Yevamot 1:1, Nedarim 8:5, and Sotah 9:3.

Remaining low exact-token scores were inspected: annotation insertions, split source tokens, spelling variants, and an extra deleted repetition in Ketubot 3:8 explain them; no additional section displacement detected.
An exact 36-letter edge check found one repeated legal formula across Yevamot 5:3/5:6; manually inspected and left in the correct supplied positions.
